newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HKFE's Rolling Forex hits record daily volume.
newsitem.headline: HKFE's Rolling Forex hits record daily volume.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange said on Wednesday its currency futures product, Rolling Forex, hit a record daily volume of 10,507 contracts on April 8-9, representing a notional value of over US$500 million.
This is the first time the trading volume of this product has reached five digits, topping the next highest record of 7,829 set on March 4 by a margin of over 34 percent.
Of the 10,507 contracts, 6,578 were Deutschmark contracts which also represented a new trading record, with the previous record being 4,137 lots set on March 4.
A total of 3,821 Japanese yen contracts and 108 British sterling contracts changed hands, the exchange said.
